image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a weasel's head and upper neck in profile, facing right. The animal has golden-brown fur on its dorsal side and lighter, cream-colored fur on its ventral side (throat/chin). It features a pointed snout, small dark eye, short rounded ear, and prominent whiskers. The background is a soft-focus mix of grey rock texture on the left and blurred green/brown foliage on the right.
